scope: application encounter-utility spells in ordinary field casting

classicSourceObservation.spellSelection: castspell.c admits inCamp records outside combat, fixes negative-cost records at power one, deducts the absolute cost, and returns the packed spell ID
classicSourceObservation.ordinaryFieldDispatch: buttonchoice.c selects the whole party for target type 11 or one character for target type 0, calls resolvespell, and plays the target-type-11 completion sound
classicSourceObservation.effectResolution: resolvespell.c rolls shared duration then damage but has no special-zero utility mutation
classicSourceObservation.encounterDispatch: encounters.c separately compares the packed selected spell ID or spell class with the authored Complex Encounter table

runtimeContract: Ordinary field use preserves each record's target shape, fixed power-one absolute spell-point cost, duration-before-damage RNG order, and target-type-11 completion sound without inventing a terrain, language, movement, or encounter mutation. Complex Encounters retain their separate authored spell-ID branch contract.
